Overview

Český Krumlov is a city in South Bohemia with a population of 13,000. A UNESCO World Heritage fairy-tale town in South Bohemia, with a stunning castle complex and perfectly preserved medieval old town. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
